value.body: A BBA track that adds data skills to management — statistics, spreadsheets, SQL and databases, data visualisation, often Python or R, and an introduction to predictive models — applied to marketing, finance and operations decisions.

items.label: Regulator
items.note: Alongside the affiliating university; BBA, BCA and BMS were brought under AICTE from 2024-25

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Admission is by Class 12 marks, CUET-UG, or a university's own test. Most students pick the specialisation in the second or third year; some institutes admit directly to a named programme. Mathematics in Class 12 is expected by some institutes for this track.

value.title: At a glance
items: Expect more maths, statistics and tool practice than in other BBA tracks.
Entry roles include data analyst, MIS executive, reporting or business analyst, and analytics trainee.
Hiring usually tests practical skills — Excel, SQL, a BI tool — and a portfolio of projects helps.
Common next steps: an MBA (often after work experience), or a master's or PG diploma in analytics or data science.
